grammatica.evidence: Declarative multi-clause textbook prose throughout: 'Photosynthesis is the process by which…'; parenthetical glosses ('a sugar that the plant uses…'); no coinages or marked register.

dialectica.evidence: Standard causal chain asserted, not derived: photon→excited e−→water split→ETC→H+ gradient→ATP synthase; NADPH; RuBisCO/Calvin→sugar. Public intro-bio mechanism, not novel inference.

rhetorica.evidence: Classic order (overview+eq→chloroplast/photon→light rxns→Calvin) then optional expansions for telos: GOE/food chains, C3/C4/CAM, ~1% efficiency/ag research—chosen from textbook option space.

arithmetica.evidence: Public facts: 6CO₂+6H₂O+light→C₆H₁₂O₆+6O₂; thylakoid/stroma; chlorophyll red/blue; NADP⁺/NADPH; RuBP/RuBisCO; 3 CO₂→one 3C sugar; 21% O₂/GOE; C4/CAM; ~1% crop efficiency.

geometria.evidence: Six sequential plain paragraphs; no headings, lists, figures, or hierarchy beyond paragraph breaks—default expository block layout.

musica.evidence: Even textbook cadence; mild triad 'from the air, water from the soil, and sunlight from above'; 'Meanwhile,' hinge; steady multi-clause pacing without marked figures.

astronomia.evidence: Default textbook arc: definition→site/photon→light stage→Calvin→biosphere significance→pathway variants→efficiency limits; even intensity, no original trajectory.

notes: Named all-stock; content fully public intro-bio. Only rhetorica is Selected (scope beyond pure mechanism: GOE, C3/C4/CAM, efficiency).
